policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Anderson have won four and drawn one, with twelve goals shared among seven different scorers and four conceded. Catawba, the conference's other unbeaten side, won away on the same night, and the two do not meet until October.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Mars Hill's thirteen goals are spread across eight different scorers, and no one of them has more than Logan Knight's four.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Only Anderson and Catawba remain unbeaten; Emory & Henry still have no published result at all.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Five matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and every match Emory & Henry have had so far, the latest away at Chowan.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Newberry have lost all four of the matches that carry a result, scoring twice and conceding eleven. Giuseppe Gereau and Shotaro Sekinada are the only players to have scored for them.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Lincoln Memorial's Daniel Benedek Miklosi has made twenty saves and conceded five, without yet keeping a clean sheet.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Wingate have scored four and conceded three, and have gone from two wins without conceding to two defeats in a row.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Anderson's Asher Risell has kept two clean sheets and conceded three goals.
